svg.text: I have always been fascinated with technology and development in computing; there is
so much potential to create marvels that have the potential to change our lives for the
better. Coding is about solving one big problem and once I do, the feeling drives me to
become better. Outside of work I love gaming, particularly tabletop role-playing games
such as Dungeons and Dragons which I try to play every week — I also enjoy reading
sci-fi novels while I am travelling.
